title: Contract Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description Hy Tech Pro is seeking an experienced and detail-driven Contract Manager to manage and govern customer contracts for our US-based clients. This role is responsible for overseeing the full contract lifecycle post-quote creation, ensuring legal, commercial, and financial compliance across IT services engagements. The Contract Manager will work closely with sales, delivery, finance, and legal stakeholders to mitigate risk, ensure contractual accuracy, and support smooth execution of client engagements. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform detailed contract reviews after quote creation to ​ ensure alignment with approved commercial terms, scope, pricing, and US legal standards. Manage contract modifications, including adding or removing services, preparing amendments, and adjusting quotes in collaboration with sales and finance teams. Review customer contracts to process disconnects, terminations, and service changes, ensuring adherence to termination, notice, and cancellation clauses. Calculate and validate Early Termination Fees (ETFs) in accordance with contractual terms and US commercial practices. Serve as a key point of coordination between sales, project managers, implementation teams, finance, and legal to ensure seamless transition from deal closure to delivery. Manage contract-related activities within a queue- or ticket-based system, prioritizing workload while maintaining exceptional accuracy and attention to detail. Ensure timely completion of contract deliverables, particularly during end-of-month and end-of-quarter close cycles. Conduct regular audits of contracts and invoices to confirm accuracy, compliance, and alignment with agreed pricing, milestones, and service obligations. Identify contractual risks, deviations, or compliance issues and proactively work with internal stakeholders to resolve them. Maintain organized, audit-ready contract documentation and ensure version control across all contract records. Communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams, US-based clients, and external vendors regarding contract terms, revisions, clarifications, and compliance matters. Support adherence to internal governance policies and applicable US regulatory and contractual standards. Requirements Required Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) is mandatory; additional qualifications in Business Administration, Finance, or Contract Management are a plus. 4+ years of experience in contract management, legal operations, or commercial governance within an IT services or technology consulting environment. Strong working knowledge of US client contracts, including MSAs, SOWs, SLAs, change orders, amendments, and termination clauses. Experience interpreting US commercial terms related to pricing models, renewals, liability, indemnification, and termination. Proven ability to calculate financial implications such as Early Termination Fees, penalties, and service credits. Excellent analytical and legal drafting/review skills with strong attention to detail. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines, especially during quarter-end cycles. Proficiency in contract management systems, CRM tools, and Microsoft Excel; familiarity with ERP or finance systems is an advantage. Preferred Attributes: Exposure to supporting North American (US) clients in a delivery or commercial operations role. Understanding of revenue recognition concepts and contract-to-cash processes. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global delivery environment with overlapping time zones. title: SEO specialist
jobDescription:
Job Description: SEO Specialist

ROLE:
SEO Specialist Location: Noida (Hybrid) Shift: UK Role Overview
We are hiring an experience Job Description Job Description: SEO Specialist

ROLE:
SEO Specialist Location: Noida (Hybrid) Shift: UK Role Overview
We are hiring an experienced SEO Specialist / SEO Manager (5 to 8 years) who can drive consistent organic growth through a strong mix of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and performance analysis . This role requires someone who thinks in systems, spots patterns in data, and turns insights into ranking wins and qualified pipeline. Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy and Execution Own and execute the SEO roadmap to grow organic traffic, rankings, and conversions. Conduct keyword research and opportunity mapping aligned to business goals, ICP, and intent. Build content SEO plans: topic clusters, pillar pages, internal linking strategy , and content briefs for writers. Optimize existing content through content refreshes, pruning, and consolidation to improve performance. Technical SEO Perform and lead technical SEO audits : crawlability, indexing, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, redirects, canonicalization, sitemap/robots, duplicate content, pagination, and broken links. Partner with developers to implement fixes and ensure SEO best practices in releases. Monitor site health using tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs/SEMrush , etc. ASO (App Store Optimization) exposure is a plus: keyword optimization for app listings, conversion optimization (screenshots/video), ratings/reviews strategy, and performance tracking. On-Page and Content Optimization Optimize metadata, headings, schema, URL structure, image SEO, and internal links. Ensure content meets E-E-A-T expectations and is aligned to search intent and SERP patterns. Support landing page SEO improvements for higher organic conversion. Off-Page SEO and Authority Building Manage ethical link-building and digital PR initiatives (guest posts, outreach, partnerships, brand mentions). Track backlink health, disavow risks where needed, and maintain a clean link profile. Reporting and Analytics Track and report on SEO KPIs: traffic, rankings, CTR, conversions, assisted conversions, crawl/index status , and content performance. Build SEO dashboards and present insights to stakeholders with clear action plans. Run experiments (A/B where possible), document learnings, and scale what works. Requirements Required Skills and Qualifications 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in SEO (B2B, Saa S, IT services, or agency experience preferred). Strong understanding of technical SEO , including audits and working with dev teams. Proven ability to improve rankings and grow organic traffic + conversions (not just vanity keywords). Expertise in keyword research, competitor analysis, on-page SEO, and content planning . Strong working knowledge of: Google Search Console, GA4 SEO suites: Ahrefs / SEMrush Crawling tools: Screaming Frog / Sitebulb Reporting: Looker Studio / Excel Comfortable with data, attribution thinking, and communicating impact clearly. Project Manager
jobDescription: Job Description Successfully manage multiple internal IT projects simultaneously through the entire lifecycle (planning > execution > close-out). • Coordinate priorities across departments, balancing competing needs while ensuring alignment with organizational goals. • Drive planning, resource allocation, and prioritization to manage overlapping workstreams. • Manage and report on project status to key stakeholders and managers for project radiation through meaningful transparency. • Manage project backlog, sprint planning, and reporting through Azure Dev Ops. • Monitor and report on project health including milestones, percent complete, budget vs. actuals, risks, and issues. • Proactively identify, document, and mitigate project issues and risks while escalating critical issues appropriately. • Build strong cross-functional relationships and foster an environment of collaboration across dynamic teams. • Facilitate discovery and documentation of software configurations and enhancements, supporting successful delivery and transition to the PMO and Product Management for roadmap consideration. • Support the PMO by driving process, project, and product improvements by identifying gaps through analysis and retrospectives, documenting findings, and scaling best practices across the organization. • Provide structured, transparent, supporting, and consistent communication to stakeholders of all levels. • Contribute to capacity/resource management and ensure the effective use of team member utilization. What Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, or Project Management. • 5-10 years of IT or product-related Project Management experience for medium to large projects. • Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Iterative) with hands-on experience in backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. • Demonstrated experience with Azure Dev Ops (or equivalent) across backlog management, sprint planning, dashboards, reporting, and team tracking. • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Suite (Excel, Word, Power Point, Teams). • Proven ability to manage multiple, concurrent projects across teams and departments. • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with experience managing cross-functional teams. • Risk management expertise, including the identification, escalation, and creation of recovery plans. • Excellent time management and disciplined work habits, with he ability to work calmly under pressure while applying strong conflict management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. • Experience leading process improvement initiatives within a PMO or department • Project Management certification or education specialization (CAPM, PMP, Scrum Master) with a focus on demonstrating a deeper commitment to the field beyond initial schooling. title: Full Stack Microsoft Web Developer
jobDescription: Job Description Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications hosted on Microsoft Azure. Build and maintain backend services using C# and .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+). Develop, integrate, and consume RESTful APIs and web services. Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases, schemas, and queries. Implement frontend features using Razor Pages/MVC and React (or similar Java Script frameworks). Collaborate with architects, product owners, and UI/UX teams to translate requirements into technical solutions. Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability. Participate in code reviews and follow best practices for clean, maintainable code. Support CI/CD pipelines and manage deployments within Azure environments. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across frontend, backend, and cloud layers. Technical Skills & Capabilities: Strong proficiency in C# and .NET for backend development. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services such as App Services, Azure SQL, Storage, and related components. Solid understanding of SQL Server and relational database design. Experience developing and consuming REST APIs. Frontend development experience using Razor Pages or MVC frameworks. Experience with React or similar Java Script frameworks (Angular, Vue) with strong Java Script fundamentals. Strong understanding of full stack web application architecture. Requirements Additional Capabilities (Good to Have): Experience with Azure Functions or serverless architectures. Familiarity with Dev Ops practices and CI/CD pipelines. Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth, Open ID Connect). Knowledge of modern UI frameworks and responsive design principles. Work Environment: Agile, collaborative development environment. Cloud-first architecture built on Microsoft technologies. Opportunity to work across frontend, backend, and cloud platforms in a full stack role.
